title: Heidi and Otto — Speaking proof
productionNotes: Animate the supplied populated frame as a speaking-animal movie shot. Exactly TWO photorealistic Bernese Mountain Dogs: HEIDI elderly silver muzzle burgundy collar LEFT foreground; OTTO stocky ochre collar RIGHT background. The spoken voice originates visibly from HEIDI: synchronize her canine jaw and muzzle to EVERY spoken word. This is ON-CAMERA CHARACTER DIALOGUE, NOT narration or voiceover. Clearly visible speech articulation while preserving canine anatomy: no human lips or teeth. Only Otto keeps his mouth closed. No humans, extra animals, figures in background, props, camera moves or cuts. Same low older female voice throughout.
